title: Heading Outline
summary: Shows the live heading outline of a Markdown draft or page region and flags skipped levels and fake headings that confuse screen reader users.
description: Live heading outline for a Markdown draft or DOM region. Flags skipped levels (shown as dashed ghost rows), extra or missing H1s, empty headings, bold text posing as a heading and overlong headings, with a one-tap level fix and rows that jump to the heading.
catches: More than one H1, or none
Bold lines that look like headings but aren't
Headings long enough to be paragraphs
limits: DOM mode reads headings and role=heading; it skips hidden content but cannot judge whether heading text is meaningful
Markdown mode parses ATX, setext and single-line HTML headings, not every Markdown dialect
One outline check, not a full WCAG audit
a11y: Summary line is a polite live region
Jump focuses the heading (adding tabindex=-1 when needed); smooth scroll is skipped under reduced motion
Focus returns to a nearby row after a fix
stops: Skipped heading levels confuse screen readers
